text:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — we need a lightweight rollout plan for the customer-driven model switch (EU customers only, opt-in). Goal: low blast radius, predictable latency, and a clear rollback path. Thoughts?

Jon (Eng): +1. propose: shadow -> 1% traffic -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with telemetry gates at each step. keep canary window = 30m for latency/5xx, 3h for quality signals.

Sam (SRE): 30m is fine for infra signals. need a hard SLA gate for cpu/GPU thermal spikes and routing fallbacks. If any pod error rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive windows, auto-evict.

Priya (Solutions): Ops ask: allow a small set of VIP customers to opt-out of autoswap during the test — we have 3 enterprise customers who want control. Also, add a customer-exempt flag.

Maya (CS): Confirmed — the 3 customers are onboard with staged opt-in and want a notification 24h before each ramp.

Anya (PM): Good. We'll add a feature flag: `model_switch_eu_v2` + a taggable `exempt_customers` list. Keep default off. Priya, can you own the flag docs + API for adding exemptions?

Priya (Solutions): I can. I'll add an admin endpoint `POST /flags/:flagName/exempt` and a UI row in Console. ETA end of day tomorrow for the docs.

Jon (Eng): For the canary itself: plan to run the model variant on a dedicated pool with a capacity multiplier so we don't starve hosted traffic. Routing policy: regional first, then fallback to older model if node capacity is exhausted. We'll wire a `fallback_priority` list.

Sam (SRE): Add a circuit-breaker that routes to fallback model after 5s queue time. Also require prefix cache warmup before ramping beyond 10%.

Lee (Marketing): Small ask — any customer-visible change should include a short changelog blurb and a microsite note. I'll draft once Priya confirms exemptions API.

Anya (PM): Metrics to gate on: p50/p95 latency delta, 5xx rate, cost-per-request delta, and a small-quality regression metric (semantic similarity on sample prompts). Thresholds: p95 delta < +80ms, 5xx < 0.5%, quality regression < 2% on the sample set.

Jon (Eng): For the quality signal, we can run a smoke eval harness against 2k prompts in shadow mode. We'll surface a rolling regression percent. Need to nail the baseline test set (no PII).

Priya (Solutions): I'll coordinate with Maya for the sample prompts and customer consent. We'll keep the sample set stable across ramps.

Sam (SRE): Runbook additions: explicit kill-switch in Console, slack alert to #eng-oncall + #product, and a mandatory post-mortem for any auto-evict. Also annotate incidents with `rollout_id`.

Anya (PM): Deployment plan summary: 1) Shadow (24h) — no customer traffic. 2) 1% (30m windows x 6 ramps) — monitor infra & quality. 3) 10% (3h) — require cache warm and telemetry green. 4) 50% (6h) — final capacity check. 5) 100% and flip flag default to on. Exempt customers unaffected unless they opt-in.

Jon (Eng): I'll add the flag config and the routing fallback config. Proposed config snippet:```json
{
  "flag": "model_switch_eu_v2",
  "steps": [
    {"type":"shadow","duration":"24h"},
    {"type":"ramp","targets":[1,10,50,100],"windows":[30m,3h,6h,1h]}
  ],
  "exempt_customers": []
}
```

Priya (Solutions): Docs + API work queued. I'll post links when ready.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: `model_switch_eu_v2` shadow start at 2026-04-02T13:00Z — invoked by Jon.

Maya (CS): I'll send the 24h notification template to the 3 customers once we have schedule details.

Anya (PM): Next steps: Jon -> flag + fallback config PR, Sam -> runbook + alerting hooks, Priya -> exemptions endpoint + docs, Maya -> customer comms, Lee -> marketing blurb. Checkback in 24h here and in shiproom if any blocker. :thumbsup:

Sam (SRE): Noted. I'll add alarm thresholds to the sprint board and create the postmortem template.

Jon (Eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/782 — includes routing policy and fallback priority. Please review.

Priya (Solutions): Docs draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/flags/model_switch_eu_v2 (WIP).

Anya (PM): Thanks all. If no objections, we'll kick the shadow tomorrow.

Maya (CS): No objections from CS.

Lee (Marketing): No objections. I'll prep a short post for EU customers.

Anya (PM): All right — kicking off in 24h unless someone calls it out now.
